title: Bind frozen candidates to strict T-3 shadow decisions and a read-only report
hypothesis: A bounded adapter can consume only the hash-verified EXP010 candidate-freeze records, capture the exact candidate WIDE quote before the strict T-3 cutoff, fail closed on schedule, universe, scratch, quote, or timing violations, and append one reproducible shadow decision per target without changing a candidate or touching an order path.
null_hypothesis: The adapter cannot produce a complete append-only decision denominator without backfilling a missed cutoff, accepting a late or ambiguous quote, changing a candidate pair, using a failed source row, mutating the production dashboard, or invoking an order-capable path.
racing_mechanism: The non-odds Top3-set model fixes the candidate pair before market access. Strict T-3 supplies only the contemporaneous price needed to choose PAPER_READY versus NO_BET for that same pair; source failures and confidence failures remain NO_BET. This separates candidate quality from price availability and prevents market-driven pair substitution.
target_population: All 36 EXP010 rows for the 2026-08-02 Sapporo, Chukyo, and Niigata cards remain in the denominator: 25 approved candidate-ready rows and 11 deterministic CANDIDATE_SOURCE_NOT_READY rows. Only a candidate-ready row may enter quote evaluation. Any T-3 cutoff already missed when authorized execution begins is recorded as NO_BET and is never backfilled.
in_scope: Add a synthetic-only adapter from hash-verified EXP010 candidate records to strict T-3 capture packets during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
Add deterministic failure mapping from CANDIDATE_SOURCE_NOT_READY to NO_BET_SOURCE_NOT_READY
Add exact race, WIDE ticket type, and exact frozen pair quote validation
Add schedule version, starter-universe, scratch-known-by-T3, quote source time, quote received time, quote selected-asof time, and decision deadline assertions
Add an append-only idempotent shadow decision ledger retaining all 36 target rows
Add a read-only static research report generated only from candidate and decision ledgers and separate from the production dashboard
After separate APPROVED_TO_RUN, make bounded public pre-race requests only for still-on-time candidate-ready rows
Capture measurement quotes for candidate-ready confidence-fail rows while forcing their action to NO_BET_CONFIDENCE_GATE_FAILED
Keep the fixed minimum robust expected return at 1.5 with no threshold search
Use synthetic fixtures only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
out_of_scope: Any candidate generation, candidate reranking, candidate replacement, alternative-pair search, or odds-based target selection
Any backfill after a strict T-3 cutoff or retrospective promotion of a failed row
Any training, refit, calibration change, threshold search, backtest, ROI calculation, or outcome join
Any final odds, payout, result, popularity, market rank, or current-day result as a candidate or action input
Any production dashboard mutation, notification, credential access, purchase adapter, target handoff, order transmission, or nonzero stake
Any formal BUY or representation of PAPER_READY as a purchase recommendation
Any real candidate, schedule, universe, scratch, or quote row during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
raw_data_sources: EXP010 approved-for-shadow review artifact with review digest 5159af600490015bab023c9c34483bf584e2af0a1fb8b9f8f5f9d7ce78815fba
Public pre-race schedule, starter-universe, scratch, and exact candidate WIDE quote observations only after a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant
data_as_of: At 2026-08-02T11:48:31+09:00, only the approved EXP010 review, candidate ledgers, packet hashes, statuses, and registered schedule metadata were inspected. No current odds, result, payout, or post-race row was inspected for proposal construction.
lineage_hash_requirements: Each EXP010 source candidate ledger hash must equal the approved review artifact
Each candidate record hash and packet file hash must verify before odds access
Only CANDIDATE_READY records may enter quote evaluation
The 11 source failures must remain present as deterministic NO_BET rows
The exact candidate race, ticket type, unordered pair, and candidate freeze hash are bound into each capture packet
Schedule, starter-universe, scratch, quote, decision, config, code, and report artifacts are SHA-256 bound
Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
The read-only report consumes ledgers and never recomputes candidates or decisions

chronological_fold_design.design: One engineering cohort over the fixed 36 EXP010 targets. Preparation uses synthetic fixtures only. After separate run approval, each row is resolved once in chronological post-time order.
chronological_fold_design.denominator_rule: All 36 rows are retained whether candidate generation, confidence, quote acquisition, or contract validation succeeds or fails.
chronological_fold_design.candidate_rule: Candidate pair and confidence result are read from the immutable EXP010 record before any odds access and never changed.
chronological_fold_design.measurement_rule: All still-on-time CANDIDATE_READY rows may capture their exact pair quote; confidence-fail rows remain forced NO_BET and are measurement-only.
chronological_fold_design.quote_rule: Polling may begin at T-3:30. Only a unique exact-pair quote whose source, received, and selected-asof times are all at or before T-3 may be latched.
chronological_fold_design.decision_rule: The decision must commit by T-2:50. Missing, late, stale, ambiguous, suspended, schedule-invalid, scratch-invalid, or universe-changed observations become NO_BET.
chronological_fold_design.late_rule: A cutoff missed before authorized execution is a terminal recorded NO_BET; no historical or final quote may replace it.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real target or quote data is read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.

purge_embargo.candidate_embargo: No candidate may be created or changed after the EXP010 freeze event.
purge_embargo.quote_embargo: No quote received or selected after the strict T-3 cutoff is eligible.
purge_embargo.result_embargo: No result, final quote, payout, or post-race information is available to this experiment.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 rows are fixed before quote evaluation; quote availability cannot remove a row from the denominator.

primary_metric.name: strict_t3_shadow_ledger_contract_completeness
primary_metric.baseline: EXP010 has 36 candidate-freeze rows but no strict T-3 quote, decision, or user-readable shadow decision artifact.
primary_metric.evaluation: Fraction of all 36 fixed targets represented exactly once with a valid deterministic terminal shadow status and no safety or chronology violation.

rejection_gate: Any of the 36 fixed targets is missing or duplicated after its cutoff
Any source-failure row enters quote evaluation or receives a candidate pair
Any candidate race, pair, ticket type, confidence result, or freeze hash changes after odds access
Any quote with source, received, or selected-asof time after T-3 is used
Any quote without a unique exact race, WIDE ticket type, and exact frozen pair is used
Any schedule ambiguity, known-by-T3 scratch, starter-universe mismatch, stale feed, or suspended market is accepted
Any production dashboard, notification, credential, purchase, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order side effect occurs
Any ROI, result, payout, popularity, market rank, final odds, or alternative pair influences the decision
stop_conditions: A required EXP010 ledger or candidate-record hash does not verify
The quote source does not expose enough source-time information to prove strict T-3 availability
Three consecutive public quote requests are unavailable or access-limited
A login challenge, CAPTCHA, access restriction, credential request, or protected endpoint is encountered
A candidate substitution, dashboard mutation, notification, purchase, or order-capable path would be required
Any safety flag cannot remain false or stake cannot remain zero
